description: Test file for the 'cel' package, containing unit tests for value conversions, equality, list and map operations, and object handling within the Kubernetes CEL implementation.

methods.name: TestConvertToType
methods.description: Unit test for converting various Go values to CEL types and verifying their type names and equality.

methods.name: TestEqual
methods.description: Unit test for equality comparison of various CEL dynamic values.

methods.name: TestListValueAdd
methods.description: Unit test for adding lists within CEL list values and converting to native Go slices.

methods.name: TestListValueContains
methods.description: Unit test for checking containment of elements in CEL list values.

methods.name: TestListValueContainsNestedList
methods.description: Unit test for containment checks involving nested list values.

methods.name: TestListValueConvertToNative
methods.description: Unit test for converting CEL list values to native Go slices of various types.

methods.name: TestListValueIterator
methods.description: Unit test for iterating over CEL list values.

methods.name: TestMapValueConvertToNative
methods.description: Unit test for converting CEL map values to native Go maps.

methods.name: TestMapValueEqual
methods.description: Unit test for equality comparison of CEL map values.

methods.name: TestMapValueNotEqual
methods.description: Unit test for inequality detection in CEL map values.

methods.name: TestMapValueIsSet
methods.description: Unit test for checking if keys are set in CEL map values.

methods.name: TestObjectValueEqual
methods.description: Unit test for equality comparison of CEL object values converted from maps.
